2024年全国高中数学联赛二试A卷第4题（50分）。
原题：A、B为正整数，S是正整数的集合，满足：(1)A^k∈S对一切非负整数k；(2)若n∈S，其所有正约数均属于S；(3)若m,n∈S且gcd(m,n)=1，则mn∈S；(4)若n∈S，则An+B∈S。证明每个与B互素的正整数都属于S。
我的完整证明：
第1步。由(1)取k=0得到1∈S。我们先证明任意n∈S及任意k≥0，A^k n∈S。将n唯一拆成n=n_0 n_A，其中gcd(n_0,A)=1且n_A的每个素因子整除A；于是gcd(n_0,n_A)=1，且n_0|n，故由(2)知n_0∈S。
第2步。对给定k≥0，因n_A所有素因子都整除A，可选足够大的正整数M使A^k n_A整除A^M。由(1)(2)得A^k n_A∈S。gcd(n_0,A^k n_A)=1，由(3)得n_0(A^k n_A)=A^k n∈S。这个结论对A=1也成立（n_A=1）。
第3步。由第2步及(4)，对任意n∈S与任意k≥1，A^k n+B=A(A^(k-1)n)+B∈S。
第4步。关键引理：对任意n∈S，n+B∈S。令t=n+B，将t=t_A t_0，其中t_A由t中所有整除A的素数幂组成，gcd(t_0,A)=1，且gcd(t_A,t_0)=1。因为t_A整除某个A^M，由(1)(2)知t_A∈S。
第5步。若t_0=1则t_0=1∈S；若t_0>1，因为gcd(A,t_0)=1，欧拉定理给出某个正整数k使A^k≡1 (mod t_0)。于是A^k n+B≡n+B=t≡0 (mod t_0)。由第3步A^k n+B∈S、由(2)得t_0∈S。再由(3)与gcd(t_A,t_0)=1得n+B=t_A t_0∈S。关键引理得证。
第6步。因为1∈S，反复应用第4、5步得到1+jB∈S，对每个非负整数j成立（对j归纳）。
第7步。任取正整数n满足gcd(n,B)=1。Bezout恒等式保证存在整数x,j使nx=1+jB；通过把x,j同时按通解调整，可取x≥1且j≥0。因而nx=1+jB∈S；再由(2)及n|nx，得到n∈S。任意与B互素的正整数都属于S。证毕。

result.statement: ∀ (A B : ℕ) (S : Set ℕ), 0 < A → 0 < B → (∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S → 0 < n) → (∀ k : ℕ, A ^ k ∈ S) → (∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S → ∀ d : ℕ, d ∣ n → 0 < d → d ∈ S) → (∀ m n : ℕ, m ∈ S → n ∈ S → Nat.Coprime m n → m * n ∈ S) → (∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S → A * n + B ∈ S) → (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Nat.Coprime n B → n ∈ S)
result.proofTerm:
by
  intro A B S hA hB hpos hpow hdiv hmul hstep
  have source_step_0 : 1 ∈ S ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S → ∃ n0 nA : ℕ, n = n0 * nA ∧ Nat.Coprime n0 A ∧ (∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ nA → p ∣ A) ∧ Nat.Coprime n0 nA ∧ n0 ∣ n ∧ n0 ∈ S) := by
    constructor
    · simpa using hpow 0
    · intro n hn
      classical
      have hnpos : 0 < n := hpos n hn
      have hnne : n ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hnpos
      let n0 : ℕ := ∏ p in n.factorization.support.filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ A), p ^ (n.factorization p)
      let nA : ℕ := ∏ p in n.factorization.support.filter (fun p => p ∣ A), p ^ (n.factorization p)
      have hprod : n0 * nA = n := by
        dsimp [n0, nA]
        calc
          (∏ p in n.factorization.support.filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ A), p ^ (n.factorization p)) *
          (∏ p in n.factorization.support.filter (fun p => p ∣ A), p ^ (n.factorization p))
              = (∏ p in n.factorization.support.filter (fun p => p ∣ A), p ^ (n.factorization p)) *
                (∏ p in n.factorization.support.filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ A), p ^ (n.factorization p)) := by rw [mul_comm]
          _ = ∏ p in n.factorization.support, p ^ (n.factorization p) := by
              exact Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not (s := n.factorization.support)
                (p := fun p => p ∣ A) (f := fun p => p ^ (n.factorization p))
          _ = n := Nat.prod_pow_factorization_eq_self hnne
      have hn0pos : 0 < n0 := by
        dsimp [n0]
        apply Finset.prod_pos
        intro q hq
        have hqsup : q ∈ n.factorization.support := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
        exact pow_pos (Nat.prime_of_mem_factorization hqsup).pos _
      have hn0dvd : n0 ∣ n := ⟨nA, hprod.symm⟩
      have hn0S : n0 ∈ S := hdiv n hn n0 hn0dvd hn0pos
      have hnAprime : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ nA → p ∣ A := by
        intro p hp hpdvd
        dsimp [nA] at hpdvd
        rcases (hp.dvd_finset_prod_iff).mp hpdvd with ⟨q, hq, hpqpow⟩
        have hqA : q ∣ A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
        exact dvd_trans (hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hpqpow) hqA
      have hcop_n0_A : Nat.Coprime n0 A := by
        dsimp [n0]
        apply Nat.Coprime.prod_left
        intro q hq
        have hqsup : q ∈ n.factorization.support := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
        have hqnot : ¬ q ∣ A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
        have hqprime : Nat.Prime q := Nat.prime_of_mem_factorization hqsup
        have hqcop : Nat.Coprime q A := (hqprime.coprime_iff_not_dvd).2 hqnot
        exact hqcop.pow_left _
      have hcop_n0_nA : Nat.Coprime n0 nA := by
        dsimp [nA]
        apply Nat.Coprime.prod_right
        intro q hq
        have hqA : q ∣ A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
        have hqcop : Nat.Coprime n0 q := hcop_n0_A.coprime_dvd_right hqA
        exact hqcop.pow_right _
      exact ⟨n0, nA, hprod.symm, hcop_n0_A, hnAprime, hcop_n0_nA, hn0dvd, hn0S⟩
  have source_step_1 : ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S → ∀ k : ℕ, A ^ k * n ∈ S := by
    intro n hn k
    classical
    rcases source_step_0.2 n hn with ⟨n0, nA, hn_eq, hcop_n0_A, hnAprime, hcop_n0_nA, hn0dvd, hn0S⟩
    have hnApos : 0 < nA := by
      by_contra h
      have hnA0 : nA = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h
      have hn0eq : n = 0 := by
        simpa [hnA0] using hn_eq
      exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (hpos n hn)) hn0eq
    have h_dvd_pow : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → (∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ m → p ∣ A) → m ∣ A ^ m := by
      intro m
      induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h m ih =>
        intro hm hprop
        by_cases hm1 : m = 1
        · subst m
          simp
        · have hm_gt1 : 1 < m := by omega
          obtain ⟨p, hp, hpm⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hm_gt1
          have hp_pos : 0 < p := hp.pos
          have hp_ge2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
          let m' := m / p
          have hp_le_m : p ≤ m := Nat.le_of_dvd hm hpm
          have hm'_pos : 0 < m' := by
            dsimp [m']
            exact Nat.div_pos hp_le_m hp_pos
          have hm'_lt : m' < m := by
            dsimp [m']
            exact Nat.div_lt_self hm (by omega : 1 < p)
          have hm_eq : p * m' = m := by
            dsimp [m']
            rw [mul_comm]
            exact Nat.div_mul_cancel hpm
          have hprop' : ∀ q, Nat.Prime q → q ∣ m' → q ∣ A := by
            intro q hq hqm'
            apply hprop q hq
            rw [← hm_eq]
            rcases hqm' with ⟨c, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨p * c, by ring⟩
          have hdiv_m' : m' ∣ A ^ m' := ih m' hm'_lt hm'_pos hprop'
          have hpA : p ∣ A := hprop p hp hpm
          have h1 : p * m' ∣ A * A ^ m' := mul_dvd_mul hpA hdiv_m'
          have hExp : m' + 1 ≤ m := by
            rw [hm_eq]
            have hm'_ge1 : 1 ≤ m' := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hm'_pos
            nlinarith
          have h2 : A * A ^ m' ∣ A ^ m := by
            have hpow : A * A ^ m' = A ^ (m' + 1) := by
              rw [mul_comm, pow_succ]
            rw [hpow]
            exact pow_dvd_pow A hExp
          have hfinal : p * m' ∣ A ^ m := dvd_trans h1 h2
          rw [hm_eq] at hfinal
          exact hfinal
    have hM : nA ∣ A ^ nA := h_dvd_pow nA hnApos hnAprime
    have hAk_dvd : A ^ k * nA ∣ A ^ (k + nA) := by
      rw [pow_add]
      exact mul_dvd_mul (dvd_refl (A ^ k)) hM
    have hAkS : A ^ k * nA ∈ S :=
      hdiv (A ^ (k + nA)) (hpow (k + nA)) (A ^ k * nA) hAk_dvd (mul_pos (pow_pos hA k) hnApos)
    have hkA_cop : Nat.Coprime n0 (A ^ k) := hcop_n0_A.pow_right k
    have hcop_all : Nat.Coprime n0 (A ^ k * nA) := hkA_cop.mul_right hcop_n0_nA
    have hprodS : n0 * (A ^ k * nA) ∈ S := hmul n0 (A ^ k * nA) hn0S hAkS hcop_all
    simpa [hn_eq, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hprodS
  have source_step_2 : ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S → ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → A ^ k * n + B ∈ S := by
    intro n hn k hk
    have hS : A ^ (k - 1) * n ∈ S := source_step_1 n hn (k - 1)
    have hstepS : A * (A ^ (k - 1) * n) + B ∈ S := hstep (A ^ (k - 1) * n) hS
    have hpow : A * A ^ (k - 1) = A ^ k := by
      rw [mul_comm, ← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]
    have hcalc : A * (A ^ (k - 1) * n) = A ^ k * n := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, hpow]
    simpa [hcalc] using hstepS
  have source_step_3 : ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S → ∃ tA t0 : ℕ, n + B = tA * t0 ∧ 0 < tA ∧ 0 < t0 ∧ Nat.Coprime t0 A ∧ Nat.Coprime tA t0 ∧ (∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ tA → p ∣ A) ∧ (∃ M : ℕ, tA ∣ A ^ M) ∧ tA ∈ S := by
    intro n hn
    classical
    let t := n + B
    have htpos : 0 < t := by
      dsimp [t]
      exact Nat.add_pos_left (hpos n hn) B
    have htne : t ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt htpos
    let t0 : ℕ := ∏ p in t.factorization.support.filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ A), p ^ (t.factorization p)
    let tA : ℕ := ∏ p in t.factorization.support.filter (fun p => p ∣ A), p ^ (t.factorization p)
    have ht_eq : tA * t0 = t := by
      dsimp [tA, t0]
      calc
        (∏ p in t.factorization.support.filter (fun p => p ∣ A), p ^ (t.factorization p)) *
        (∏ p in t.factorization.support.filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ A), p ^ (t.factorization p))
            = ∏ p in t.factorization.support, p ^ (t.factorization p) := by
              exact Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not (s := t.factorization.support)
                (p := fun p => p ∣ A) (f := fun p => p ^ (t.factorization p))
        _ = t := Nat.prod_pow_factorization_eq_self htne
    have htA_pos : 0 < tA := by
      dsimp [tA]
      apply Finset.prod_pos
      intro q hq
      have hqsup : q ∈ t.factorization.support := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
      exact pow_pos (Nat.prime_of_mem_factorization hqsup).pos _
    have ht0_pos : 0 < t0 := by
      dsimp [t0]
      apply Finset.prod_pos
      intro q hq
      have hqsup : q ∈ t.factorization.support := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
      exact pow_pos (Nat.prime_of_mem_factorization hqsup).pos _
    have htA_prime : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ tA → p ∣ A := by
      intro p hp hpdvd
      dsimp [tA] at hpdvd
      rcases (hp.dvd_finset_prod_iff).mp hpdvd with ⟨q, hq, hpqpow⟩
      have hqA : q ∣ A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
      exact dvd_trans (hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hpqpow) hqA
    have hcop_t0_A : Nat.Coprime t0 A := by
      dsimp [t0]
      apply Nat.Coprime.prod_left
      intro q hq
      have hqsup : q ∈ t.factorization.support := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
      have hqnot : ¬ q ∣ A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
      have hqprime : Nat.Prime q := Nat.prime_of_mem_factorization hqsup
      have hqcop : Nat.Coprime q A := (hqprime.coprime_iff_not_dvd).2 hqnot
      exact hqcop.pow_left _
    have hcop_tA_t0 : Nat.Coprime tA t0 := by
      dsimp [tA]
      apply Nat.Coprime.prod_left
      intro q hq
      have hqA : q ∣ A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
      have hqcop0 : Nat.Coprime q t0 := (hcop_t0_A.coprime_dvd_right hqA).symm
      exact hqcop0.pow_left _
    have h_dvd_pow : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → (∀ p, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ m → p ∣ A) → m ∣ A ^ m := by
      intro m
      induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h m ih =>
        intro hm hprop
        by_cases hm1 : m = 1
        · subst m
          simp
        · have hm_gt1 : 1 < m := by omega
          obtain ⟨p, hp, hpm⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hm_gt1
          have hp_pos : 0 < p := hp.pos
          have hp_ge2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
          let m' := m / p
          have hp_le_m : p ≤ m := Nat.le_of_dvd hm hpm
          have hm'_pos : 0 < m' := by
            dsimp [m']
            exact Nat.div_pos hp_le_m hp_pos
          have hm'_lt : m' < m := by
            dsimp [m']
            exact Nat.div_lt_self hm (by omega : 1 < p)
          have hm_eq : p * m' = m := by
            dsimp [m']
            rw [mul_comm]
            exact Nat.div_mul_cancel hpm
          have hprop' : ∀ q, Nat.Prime q → q ∣ m' → q ∣ A := by
            intro q hq hqm'
            apply hprop q hq
            rw [← hm_eq]
            rcases hqm' with ⟨c, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨p * c, by ring⟩
          have hdiv_m' : m' ∣ A ^ m' := ih m' hm'_lt hm'_pos hprop'
          have hpA : p ∣ A := hprop p hp hpm
          have h1 : p * m' ∣ A * A ^ m' := mul_dvd_mul hpA hdiv_m'
          have hExp : m' + 1 ≤ m := by
            rw [hm_eq]
            have hm'_ge1 : 1 ≤ m' := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hm'_pos
            nlinarith
          have h2 : A * A ^ m' ∣ A ^ m := by
            have hpow : A * A ^ m' = A ^ (m' + 1) := by
              rw [mul_comm, pow_succ]
            rw [hpow]
            exact pow_dvd_pow A hExp
          have hfinal : p * m' ∣ A ^ m := dvd_trans h1 h2
          rw [hm_eq] at hfinal
          exact hfinal
    have htA_dvd_pow : tA ∣ A ^ tA := h_dvd_pow tA htA_pos htA_prime
    let M := tA
    have htA_dvd_AM : tA ∣ A ^ M := by simpa [M] using htA_dvd_pow
    have htA_S : tA ∈ S := hdiv (A ^ M) (hpow M) tA htA_dvd_AM htA_pos
    refine ⟨tA, t0, ?_, htA_pos, ht0_pos, hcop_t0_A, hcop_tA_t0, htA_prime, ⟨M, htA_dvd_AM⟩, htA_S⟩
    dsimp [t] at ht_eq ⊢
    exact ht_eq.symm
  have source_step_4 : ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S → n + B ∈ S := by
    intro n hn
    classical
    rcases source_step_3 n hn with ⟨tA, t0, h_eq, htApos, ht0pos, hcop_t0_A, hcop_tA_t0, htAprime, hM, htAS⟩
    have ht0S : t0 ∈ S := by
      by_cases ht01 : t0 = 1
      · rw [ht01]
        exact source_step_0.1
      · have ht0gt1 : 1 < t0 := by omega
        have hcop_A_t0 : Nat.Coprime A t0 := hcop_t0_A.symm
        have hEuler : A ^ Nat.totient t0 ≡ 1 [MOD t0] := Nat.ModEq.pow_totient hcop_A_t0
        have hφpos : 1 ≤ Nat.totient t0 := by
          have : 0 < Nat.totient t0 := Nat.totient_pos (by omega : 0 < t0)
          omega
        let k := Nat.totient t0
        have hkpos : 1 ≤ k := by simpa [k] using hφpos
        have hS2 : A ^ k * n + B ∈ S := source_step_2 n hn k hkpos
        have hpow_mod : A ^ k ≡ 1 [MOD t0] := by simpa [k] using hEuler
        have hmul : A ^ k * n ≡ 1 * n [MOD t0] := hpow_mod.mul (Nat.ModEq.refl n)
        have hadd : A ^ k * n + B ≡ 1 * n + B [MOD t0] := hmul.add (Nat.ModEq.refl B)
        have hzero : 1 * n + B ≡ 0 [MOD t0] := by
          rw [Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd]
          rw [one_mul]
          rw [h_eq]
          exact dvd_mul_left t0 tA
        have hmod0 : A ^ k * n + B ≡ 0 [MOD t0] := by
          have h1 : A ^ k * n + B ≡ 1 * n + B [MOD t0] := by simpa using hadd
          exact h1.trans hzero
        have ht0dvd : t0 ∣ A ^ k * n + B := Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp hmod0
        exact hdiv (A ^ k * n + B) hS2 t0 ht0dvd ht0pos
    have hprodS : tA * t0 ∈ S := hmul tA t0 htAS ht0S hcop_tA_t0
    simpa [h_eq] using hprodS
  have source_step_5 : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 + j * B ∈ S := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simpa using source_step_0.1
    | succ j ih =>
       have h := source_step_4 (1 + j * B) ih
       convert h using 1
       ring
  have source_step_6 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Nat.Coprime n B → n ∈ S := by
    intro n hn hcop
    classical
    have hBpos : 0 < B := hB
    have hφpos : 1 ≤ Nat.totient B := by
      have : 0 < Nat.totient B := Nat.totient_pos hBpos
      omega
    have hEuler : n ^ Nat.totient B ≡ 1 [MOD B] := Nat.ModEq.pow_totient hcop
    let x := n ^ (Nat.totient B - 1)
    have hxpos : 0 < x := by
      dsimp [x]
      exact pow_pos hn _
    have hmulx : n * x = n ^ Nat.totient B := by
      dsimp [x]
      rw [mul_comm, ← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hφpos]
    have hdvd : B ∣ n * x - 1 := by
      have h := hEuler.dvd
      simpa [hmulx] using h
    let j := (n * x - 1) / B
    have hjmul : j * B = n * x - 1 := by
      dsimp [j]
      exact Nat.div_mul_cancel hdvd
    have hn_mul_pos : 0 < n * x := mul_pos hn hxpos
    have h_eq : n * x = 1 + j * B := by
      omega
    have hS : 1 + j * B ∈ S := source_step_5 j
    have hdvd_n : n ∣ 1 + j * B := by

第1步。由(1)取k=0得到1∈S。我们先证明任意n∈S及任意k≥0，A^k n∈S。将n唯一拆成n=n_0 n_A，其中gcd(n_0,A)=1且n_A的每个素因子整除A；于是gcd(n_0,n_A)=1，且n_0|n，故由(2)知n_0∈S。
第2步。对给定k≥0，因n_A所有素因子都整除A，可选足够大的正整数M使A^k n_A整除A^M。由(1)(2)得A^k n_A∈S。gcd(n_0,A^k n_A)=1，由(3)得n_0(A^k n_A)=A^k n∈S。这个结论对A=1也成立（n_A=1）。
第3步。由第2步及(4)，对任意n∈S与任意k≥1，A^k n+B=A(A^(k-1)n)+B∈S。
第4步。关键引理：对任意n∈S，n+B∈S。令t=n+B，将t=t_A t_0，其中t_A由t中所有整除A的素数幂组成，gcd(t_0,A)=1，且gcd(t_A,t_0)=1。因为t_A整除某个A^M，由(1)(2)知t_A∈S。
第5步。若t_0=1则t_0=1∈S；若t_0>1，因为gcd(A,t_0)=1，欧拉定理给出某个正整数k使A^k≡1 (mod t_0)。于是A^k n+B≡n+B=t≡0 (mod t_0)。由第3步A^k n+B∈S、由(2)得t_0∈S。再由(3)与gcd(t_A,t_0)=1得n+B=t_A t_0∈S。关键引理得证。

第4步。关键引理：对任意n∈S，n+B∈S。令t=n+B，将t=t_A t_0，其中t_A由t中所有整除A的素数幂组成，gcd(t_0,A)=1，且gcd(t_A,t_0)=1。因为t_A整除某个A^M，由(1)(2)知t_A∈S。
第5步。若t_0=1则t_0=1∈S；若t_0>1，因为gcd(A,t_0)=1，欧拉定理给出某个正整数k使A^k≡1 (mod t_0)。于是A^k n+B≡n+B=t≡0 (mod t_0)。由第3步A^k n+B∈S、由(2)得t_0∈S。再由(3)与gcd(t_A,t_0)=1得n+B=t_A t_0∈S。关键引理得证。
第6步。因为1∈S，反复应用第4、5步得到1+jB∈S，对每个非负整数j成立（对j归纳）。
第7步。任取正整数n满足gcd(n,B)=1。Bezout恒等式保证存在整数x,j使nx=1+jB；通过把x,j同时按通解调整，可取x≥1且j≥0。因而nx=1+jB∈S；再由(2)及n|nx，得到n∈S。任意与B互素的正整数都属于S。证毕。
